item.title: [github_trending] morluto/rea
item.description: morluto/rea is an MCP server that aims to cover reverse engineering across binaries, applications and runtime behavior in one interface, letting agents go from app behavior down to native binaries. It ships as the npm package rea-agents and requires Node.js 22 or newer, so it is aimed at developers who want to plug reverse-engineering capability into their agents.

His takeaway is that Cursor still reads as an AI coding assistant, while Codex feels closer to a general-purpose agent that carries out tasks on its own. Useful for developers deciding which tool to adopt for daily work.

item.description: Microsoft 365 storage perks are changing: cloud storage moves from 1 TB per person to 2 TB shared across the plan's members, who keep separate accounts and file privacy. The change takes effect at your first renewal after May 2, 2027. The poster suggests planning data migration ahead of time, which matters most to teams currently near their per-user storage ceiling.

item.title: [v2ex] [AI SaaS 产品推荐] Instinct AI：把视频、图像、音频与 Agent 工作流放在一起
item.description: Instinct AI is an AI creative suite that puts video, image, audio and agent workflows in one workspace, covering text-to-video, image-to-video, image generation, transparent PNG assets, music and speech, with shared credits usable across Seedance, Wan, Kling, GPT Image, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs and Suno. Launched October 1, 2026, it targets creators, marketers and e-commerce teams, priced from $9.99 per month, aiming to cut tool-switching across separate media apps.

He sticks to the VS Code Claude extension and avoids Desktop and the CLI for now, is on the Pro plan and plans to scale to 5x and eventually 20x, and wonders whether KYC plus machine hosting is a lasting business.

It walks through two drafts: one that piles on adjectives without saying where the camera lands, and a rewrite that fixes a five-second single shot, the glass shape, the orange's cut face and the push-in direction.

item.description: QCon Global Software Development Conference Shanghai runs October 22-24, where Zhou Xinyi, SRE director of Ctrip's big data platform, will present "AI + SRE ≠ AISRE" in the track on rationally governing AI in SRE reliability engineering. There's no app to install and no account to create, and it's free — the URL itself is the app. It fits anyone who needs a temporary sign without adding software or signing up.

item.description: A ByteDance second-round interview question poses the classic puzzle: 100 tigers and one sheep locked in together — does the sheep get eaten? The description says the interviewer isn't testing whether you know the standard answer, but whether you instinctively look for the simplest starting point in a problem that looks complex. So it probes how you reason rather than what you've memorized.

item.description: The author recounts funding the education of Anwarite, a girl from the Tanzanian village of Ibumila in the Njombe highlands, for ten years after staying with her family at 19. Roughly 2% of people from Njombe finish a university degree; he registered the effort as a 501(c)(3), the Tanzania Education Project, now covering fees and healthcare for five local students.

item.title: [github_trending] anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
item.description: Anthropic open-sourced 11 plugins for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork, each bundling the skills, connectors, slash commands and sub-agents for a specific job function, and they also work with Claude Code. The company says the out-of-the-box versions are only a starting point and the real value comes from customizing them with your own tools, terminology and processes.
